parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4513219. Join activities to assays on assay_id, join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN. Filter to rows where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Keep all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort the results by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
